Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final standalone brand symbol for the Chinese brand 枕星 / ZHENXING RAIL, a refined N-scale model railway knowledge, collecting, reviews, community and track-design platform. Design one distinctive, professionally restrained flat logo, not a concept sheet. Symbol: a pair of gently curving railway rails with just three solid cross sleepers forms a compact elegant upward path, ending at a single small four-point guiding star in the upper right; the silhouette subtly suggests a Z without writing a literal letter. The railway must be recognizable immediately and the star feel structurally integrated, not a generic extra sparkle. Precise geometric proportions, confident medium-heavy shapes, generous negative space, contemporary railway identity with a quiet poetic night-travel sensibility. Only two solid colors: railway in very dark forest green #203F35 and star in muted golden brass #C7A566. High contrast, clean optical balance, beautifully finished vector-like edges, no outlines around the whole icon. Background genuinely transparent with alpha, no white square, no checkerboard depicted. Square 1024 by 1024 composition with the single symbol occupying about 82 percent of canvas width/height and centered. Absolutely no typography or letters, no wordmark, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no tiny details, no circle enclosure, no train clipart, no mockups or stationery. This is an original reusable logo asset to be integrated next to a separately typeset Chinese wordmark.
